CustomField.description: One-shot signal: the Nexus Standard Support entitlement process sets it when any milestone is violated; CaseEscalationService escalates the case, stamps SLA_Violated_On__c and resets it, so every violation escalates (not only the first). Report on SLA_Violated_On__c or CaseMilestone.IsViolated instead.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automation signal (reset immediately). See SLA Violated On.
CustomField.label: SLA Violation Signal
